revision_note: HF commit hash read from the huggingface_hub cache metadata (.cache/huggingface/download/config.json.metadata, first line) of the local copy ~/jev/models/gemma-4-12b-it; the safetensors were fetched from ModelScope google/gemma-4-12b-it @ master (same release). The adapter verifies a LOCAL model dir against config_sha256 (and model_safetensors_bytes when a single model.safetensors is present) at load time and records revision_verified in raw.runtime (METASK_RAIN_STRICT_REVISION=1 makes a mismatch fatal); an HF id is loaded with revision= directly. Validator: huggingface-cli download google/gemma-4-12B-it --revision 707f0a3b8a3c7ad586ed01e27eafbad8a27dd0f7 config.json, then sha256sum it.
training: none (no fine-tune, no LoRA, no soft prompt, no per-item prompt tuning)
prompt_system_text: You are a careful, decisive judge. Read the context, apply every rule, definition, threshold, exception and date it contains, and answer the question. Reply with exactly one word and nothing else.
readout: per label: logsumexp of the last-position logits over the label's single-token surface forms; one forward pass, logits_to_keep=1

forms.single_token_rule: a form is used only if tokenizer.encode(form, add_special_tokens=False) is exactly one token (Gemma 4 tokenizer: 'A.', '(A', ' 0', '0.' are multi-token and drop out)
forms.noul_form_note: calib_gemma_report.md 3.2: the 'lower' set gives the same sign of d = lse(yes) - lse(no) as the full 12+12 set on all 74 public noul items (0 flips; min |d| 0.25). The full sets are kept below for the record and for the parity check.

precision_policy: Precision is chosen at load time from the free VRAM of the CUDA device: bf16 when >= 27 GiB are free, otherwise bitsandbytes LLM.int8; env METASK_RAIN_DTYPE=bf16|int8 overrides; nf4/4-bit is refused. Each precision has its own calibration block below, fitted on logits of that precision; the adapter uses the block matching the precision it actually loaded and records both in raw.runtime. The bf16 block was fitted on a CPU-offload run that is numerically bf16 (peak VRAM 19.7 GB on an RTX 4090); bf16 on a single GPU (no offload) has not been run on our hardware. At their own fitted values int8 and bf16 agree on 225/231 public decisions (choice 135/139, noul 72/74, score 18/18).

noul_calibration.decision: yes iff d = logsumexp(yes forms) - logsumexp(no forms) > 0
noul_calibration.reference: Zadrozny & Elkan 2001 (histogram binning), one bin per decision side

noul_alternative.note: not used by the adapter; kept for comparison

bf16.selection_rule: dev-only; maximise harmonic(I_type, C_type); choice grid 0.5..6 step 0.25; score grid {1,1.5,2,2.3,3,4,5,6,8}; ties -> first ascending

Local reconstruction of METHOD v1.5 on the 231 public items; estimates, not official. noul form-set check: sign(lower) == sign(full 12+12) on 74/74 items. int8.notes: Fit on dev 116 of split_231_v2 only; check half (115) scored once at these values: I_231 72.0, C_axis 80.6, noul abstention 0%. Full 231 for reference: I_231 69.6, C_axis 87.2. Score T 5.0 is the pre-registered dev pick; the check half was looked at once (calib_gemma, 2026-10-02) and preferred 4.0; the dev pick was kept.

noul_mapping_note: noul uses one-bin histogram calibration (Zadrozny & Elkan 2001, histogram binning with a single bin per decision side): the decision is the sign of d = logsumexp(yes forms) - logsumexp(no forms) of the frozen model (d == 0 -> no), and the reported probability is the precision of that sign rule on the dev half: P(yes) = p_cal if d > 0 else 1 - p_cal. It is a non-decreasing step function of d, not a temperature: every noul item gets one of two values, and the magnitude of d is not used. It was chosen so that no item falls in the 0.2-0.8 abstention band and the reported confidence equals the calibration-set precision. It replaces the near-argmax temperature T 0.05 of the previous revision, which is kept per block as noul_alternative (selectable with METASK_RAIN_NOUL=temperature) for comparison; at T 0.05 the decisions are identical and P(yes) is >= 0.993 or <= 0.007 on every public item.
score_temperature_note: T_score 5.0 is the pre-registered dev pick on both precisions (calib_v2.py, grid {1,1.5,2,2.3,3,4,5,6,8}). On int8 the 115-item check half was looked at once before this fit (calib_gemma, 2026-10-02) and preferred T 4.0 (check-half score I/C 81.4/86.3 at 4.0 vs 78.0/82.4 at 5.0); the previous revision of this file had shipped 4.0 for that reason. This revision keeps the pre-registered dev pick 5.0 and does not re-pick on the check half. No argmax decision differs between 4.0 and 5.0 on any of the 18 public score items; the expected position and RPS do.
fitted_on: dev half (116 items) of the 231 public items, split_231_v2.json (units = paraphrase groups; 0 groups straddle halves)
fitting_objective: per type, maximise the harmonic mean H(I_type, C_type) on dev under our local reconstruction of the METHOD v1.5 scorer; the held-out public check half (115) was scored once per precision at the picked values
method: choice and score: temperature on the per-label log-mass (argmax unchanged); noul: one-bin histogram calibration of sign(d)
max_input_tokens_note: prompts longer than 65536 tokens are refused with status 422 on both precisions; the longest public item is 3,942 tokens. selftest.sh LONG-INPUT SMOKE (int8, RTX 4090 24 GB, 2026-10-03): 18,504 tokens ok (peak 16.2 GiB allocated / 17.4 reserved, 8.7 s); 33,056 tokens ok (20.4 / 22.3 GiB, 20.7 s). Prompts between ~33k and 65536 tokens were not tried on the 24 GB card and may run out of memory there in int8; an OOM is an ordinary failed item (ok=false, no status), not a 422. bf16 on a >= 27 GiB card has not been run at any length by us.
min_transformers: 5.10.0 (first tag containing src/transformers/models/gemma4_unified; v5.9.x does not have it; 5.10.0 and 5.10.1 were both published on PyPI on 2026-06-03; tested: 5.17.0 only)
readout_no_single_token_form: a label none of whose surface forms is a single token gets log-mass -1e9 (P = 0), as in cache_verbalized.py; no public item is affected (max 5 score levels / 6 choice options)
choice_max_options_note: one option letter A..Z per option; a choice item with more than 26 options is refused by render() with an explicit ValueError (an ordinary failed item, not a 422) instead of being silently truncated; the caches never saw more than 6 options

probs_source.note: per-item DecisionResult.probs_source: native where the reported distribution is the tempered softmax of the model's own log-mass; the noul one-bin mapping reports the calibration constant p_cal, so it is labelled distinctly and summary.json probability_sources lists both values

nf4_note: nf4 is refused: on the 231 public items at the then-current temperatures (choice 1.9 / noul 0.05 / score 4.0) local I_231 was 58.2 for nf4 vs 70.0 for int8 (verb_gemma12b_nf4_scores_v2.json / verb_gemma12b_int8_scores_v2.json, full@picked)
prior_work: Same read-out family as NInfer -> Cygnet (single forward pass, probability mass of label tokens at the answer position, temperature); Cygnet pins the same HF revision. Differences: one-word verbalized prompt with surface-form log-mass, per-type temperatures, in-process transformers, one-bin noul calibration. No Cygnet code or calibration was used.
estimates_note: All per-block numbers are local reconstructions of METHOD v1.5 on the 231 public items; estimates, not official scores. No Speed, Cost or composite estimate is given.
